chunks: I said to Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام): Inform me about the saying of Allah, Blessed and Exalted.
The Trustworthy Spirit has descended with it upon your heart, that you may be among the warners, in a clear Arabic tongue.
He said: It is the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام).

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, ʿAlī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ: the Trustworthy Spirit who descends with revelation
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةُ: the divinely designated authority and guardianship
key_terms.قَلْبِكَ: your heart, the locus of receiving revelation
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the divine statement being asked about
key_terms.لِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُبِينٍ: a clear Arabic tongue, indicating lucid expression

ai.seo_question: How is the verse "The Trustworthy Spirit has descended with it... in a clear Arabic tongue" understood in relation to the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report presents the cited Qur'anic passage as referring, in its inner meaning, to the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (عليه السلام). It reflects a Shia tafsir-oriented reading in which revelation includes guidance concerning divinely appointed authority.
